comment: The CDSE, Public Health Surveillance Platform, and HMIS are described at markedly different levels of abstraction. The CDSE is an engine, the surveillance platform is a broad platform, and the HMIS can represent an entire national system.

public.text: The CDSE, Public Health Surveillance Platform, and HMIS are described at markedly different levels of abstraction. The CDSE is an engine, the surveillance platform is a broad platform, and the HMIS can represent an entire national system.
public.suggestedRevision: Normalise component granularity. Define each as a bounded capability or logical component with clear services, data responsibilities, exclusions, and interfaces.
